item.title: Tom Jones Releases New Album - Planetradio.ie
item.description: The time has come for my brand new album ‘Surrounded By Time’ to be yours! I’m so excited for you to hear these songs, so listen with open ears from start to finish and enjoy this storybook ride through time with me. I hope you love it as much as I do!
